ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (dark/black) pixels across approximately 95% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters providing sharp contrast.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity black field across the entire fluke surface. High-intensity white pixel clusters are concentrated on the distal lateral tips. Dispersed high-intensity white circular ring patterns and vertical linear streaks are mapped across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped indentation dividing the lobes with an approximate 40-degree internal angle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary. Significant jagged peaks on the upper-left lobe and a series of smaller, rhythmic saw-tooth variations on the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex outward curve from the median notch, transitioning to an upward and outward trajectory ending at the barnacle-encrusted distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct spatial clusters of white circular rings (scars) visible on the lower-left, lower-center, and lower-right quadrants. Dense, irregular high-contrast white/tan clusters (barnacles) localized on the outer lateral margins.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several high-intensity white vertical linear marks (rake marks) varying in length, positioned on the inner upper sections of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring (rosettes), multiple vertical linear abrasions (rake marks), and heavy barnacle colonization on the lateral fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly textured, protruding clusters of barnacles on the extreme lateral tips of both lobes, significantly altering the expected smooth boundary of the fluke.
